capabilities: Parse requirement frontmatter into a filterable project overview
Compare SVN working-copy snapshots and commit frontmatter changes
Generate requirement notes from a description via Templater and an LLM
Draft, preview, and send milestone emails over SMTP with sent records archived in the note
Configure OpenAI-compatible LLM providers with keys in the system keychain
disambiguation: Not a general SVN client; it only runs svn commands against your configured SVN working copy for snapshot sync and commits.
extras: Desktop only, not available on mobile. Manual install from release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css) until listed in the community directory. SVN calls use child_process.execFile with fixed argument arrays, 60s timeout, and input validation; svn is never bundled. API keys are stored via Obsidian SecretStorage in the system keychain. No telemetry.
problem: Project management busywork such as tracking requirement status, milestone progress, and stakeholder emails is scattered and manual, with no version history for note changes.

relations.evidence: The "✨ Add requirement" flow calls the Templater plugin's API (only if you have it installed & enabled)

summary: Desktop-only plugin that turns requirement notes into a project overview, syncs SVN snapshots, and uses an LLM to draft milestone emails and reminders.
